name: Grass Stage 2
summary: Stage 2 rewards are paid in USDC through your Grass dashboard. Payout ends after six months or once everything is claimed, whichever comes first.

flags.t: Unclaimed rewards stay with Grass and are not redistributed.
No closing time is stated and the pool can run out earlier, so do not wait for the last day.
Eligibility covers bandwidth provided between Oct 14, 2024 and Jun 8, 2026.

tasks: Open your Grass dashboard from the official address
Claim your Stage 2 USDC before the deadline

name: Base App Launch Rewards
who: App users under the current terms
summary: A rewards program paid in USDC for signing up, using the app, trading and inviting friends. This is not a BASE token airdrop.

flags.t: Not a BASE token airdrop. Base has only said it is exploring a network token.
Expect scam activity around year-end claims. Use only the official app and announcement.
The pool is limited and the terms can change.

tasks: Read the current terms in the official Base app
Follow only what the terms describe

name: Primus Labs
summary: Privacy-focused data verification project (formerly PADO). Its AlphaNet campaign lets users verify social identities with zkTLS proofs and build a reputation score.

flags.t: A token has not been announced by the project, as of an Oct 20, 2026 guide.
Some guides call it a "confirmed airdrop". That goes further than the project has.
A $6.5M seed round was reported in February 2025.
The AlphaNet campaign launched on October 16, 2025 and has no announced end date.

tasks: Open the AlphaNet page from Primus Labs' own official site or verified account
Connect an EVM wallet only on that official page
Install the Primus extension only from the Chrome Web Store
Never pay anyone to unlock rewards

name: Base network token
summary: Base has said it is exploring a network token. No design, eligibility rules, snapshot or launch date has been published.

flags.t: Treat any "BASE airdrop" claim as a scam until Base announces one itself.

name: MetaMask Rewards
summary: Season 1 ended in early 2026 and its claim window is closed. The current docs say there are no plans for a $MASK token.

flags.t: Some roundups list a Nov 26 deadline and a Nov 12 opt-in. MetaMask's own pages contradict this.
Anyone offering a MASK airdrop now is not following MetaMask's published plans.
